# aether_registry (Data Source)

The organization's container registry. A registry that is not enabled reads `enabled = false` with every other attribute null — it is not an error, so the data source can drive conditional configuration. Storage consumption is not reported here: see the `registry` line of `aether_cost_breakdown`'s `autoscaling` list (GiB-hours and euros).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time the registry was enabled (RFC 3339); null when not enabled.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the registry is enabled.
- `endpoint` (String) Registry host to push to and pull from; null when not enabled.
- `harbor_project` (String) Registry project name (`aether-<organization slug>`); null when not enabled.
- `id` (String) Registry id; null when not enabled. It changes when the registry is disabled and enabled again.
- `quota_gb` (Number) Storage quota in GB as recorded by the platform. It is not enforced today. Null when not enabled.
- `updated_at` (String) Last write time (RFC 3339); null when not enabled.
